items.heading: Margherita Pizza
details: Key ingredients: pizza dough, tomato sauce, fresh mozzarella, basil, olive oil
Stretch the dough into a thin round and spread a light layer of tomato sauce.
Top with torn mozzarella and a drizzle of olive oil.
Bake at the highest oven setting until the crust is charred in spots and cheese bubbles.
Finish with fresh basil leaves before serving.

items.heading: Spaghetti Carbonara
details: Key ingredients: spaghetti, eggs, pecorino cheese, guanciale or pancetta, black pepper
Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Fry the guanciale until crisp and render its fat.
Whisk eggs with grated pecorino and lots of black pepper.
Off the heat, toss hot pasta with guanciale and the egg mixture, adding pasta water until creamy.

items.heading: Tiramisu
details: Key ingredients: ladyfingers, mascarpone, eggs, sugar, espresso, cocoa powder
Whisk egg yolks with sugar, then fold in mascarpone until smooth.
Dip ladyfingers briefly in cooled espresso and layer in a dish.
Spread mascarpone mixture over each layer, repeating twice.
Chill for several hours and dust with cocoa powder before serving.

items.heading: Pizza Margherita
details: Ingredients: flour, yeast, water, salt, olive oil, tomato sauce, cheese and toppings.
Make a yeast dough, rest until doubled, stretch thin, add sauce and toppings, then bake in a very hot oven until browned.

items.heading: Pasta Carbonara
details: Ingredients: noodles/pasta, vegetables or protein, aromatics, sauce and oil.
Boil noodles until just tender.
Stir-fry or simmer the sauce ingredients, add noodles and toss until evenly coated.
